messages:
ana: CumulusCloud asked for a compact co-marketing push: marketplace listing, short benchmark blurb, and a 30-min joint webinar. Can we map owners and a minimal runbook?

raj: I can own the marketplace listing and approvals. Please send their logo pack and an approved partner sentence.

sophia: Ill grab the benchmark numbers and a 1-page methodology. Recommend we show p95 latency on 6k streaming and a simple cost delta vs baseline. Will upload draft by Tue.

mike: Ill handle webinar ops and the landing page. Proposed dates: Oct 14 or Oct 21 mornings PT. Need speaker confirmations 7 business days prior. Ill add hidden partner_tag field on the reg form.

ana: Note on leads: route marketplace leads -> partner-ops queue for 48h qualification with partner_tag=cumulus and origin=marketplace_webinar. SFDC fields: Partner_Tag__c, Lead_Origin__c.

raj: Sending Cumulus the asset checklist now. Also will draft listing copy and tag Ana for tone review.

sophia: Bench update: running 6k streaming at batch sizes 1 and 4. Early numbers look clean; will flag any variability in the doc.

mike: Promo plan: announce + reminder emails, 2 LinkedIn posts, partner amplification. Recommend $700 paid social. Ill build the reg page and GA tracking.

marketing-bot: Reminder: request co-brand assets from CumulusCloud by 2026-10-01 09:00 PT.

ana: Owners recap:
- Marketplace listing: raj
- Benchmark blurb + methodology: sophia
- Webinar ops + registration: mike
- Lead tagging & SFDC mapping: ana
- Launch copy + social: ana

raj: Please update the shared tracker by EOD Wed with ETAs. If legal or assets block, ping Partnerships. Thanks all!
